# Io-Gui

> Io-Gui is a multi-paradigm reactive web UI framework with zero runtime dependencies. Plain data models (`ReactiveObject`) and custom DOM elements (`ReactiveElement`) are vertices in a single reactive graph, so changes, mutations, and events propagate across the object/element boundary — reactivity is not tied to DOM placement. Written in TypeScript, distributed as `@io-gui/*` packages, usable without any build step.

Why use it: you need reactive state that spans data models and DOM elements without a framework boundary between them — e.g. an editor, inspector, or IDE-like tool where one model drives many views. A model can parent a DOM element (and vice versa), nodes can have multiple parents, and a visited-set circuit breaker makes diamonds and cycles in the graph safe.

How to use it: extend `ReactiveObject` for models and `ReactiveElement` for views; apply `@Register` to every subclass; declare reactive state with `@Property` (or `static Properties`) and non-reactive constructor-initialized values with `@Field`; wire two-way sync with `bind(node, 'prop')`; persist state via `Storage` bindings. Elements render via a virtual DOM of tag functions (`span(...)`, `div(...)`) returned from `render()`.

Where to find context, in reading order:

[Repository](https://github.com/io-gui/io/)

2. `CONTEXT.md` — how the modeled contexts (Core, Layout, Menus) relate to each other.
1. `packages/core/CONTEXT.md` — the pinned vocabulary of the reactive core (change vs. mutation, graph, Property vs. Field, Binding, Register). Read this first; the terms are used precisely everywhere else.
3. `docs/quick-start.md` then `docs/deep-dive.md` — usage and architecture.
4. `packages/**/docs/adr/` — records of the reasoning behind architectural design decisions.

## Docs

- [Quick Start](docs/quick-start.md): importing Io-Gui, making elements and nodes, properties, bindings, styling
- [Deep Dive](docs/deep-dive.md): the reactive architecture — property system, data flow, dispatcher, lifecycle
- [Core Context](packages/core/CONTEXT.md): canonical definitions of the framework's terms; disambiguates change/mutation, Property/Field, graph/DOM/VDOM parenthood
- [Context Map](CONTEXT.md): index of modeled contexts and the dependencies between them
- [Layout Context](packages/layout/CONTEXT.md): vocabulary of the layout system (Split/Panel/Tab models and their views)
- [Menus Context](packages/menus/CONTEXT.md): vocabulary of the menu system (Menu/Option models, dropdowns, menu bars, trees)

## Architecture Decisions

- [ReactiveNode is the graph union](docs/adr/0001-reactivenode-is-the-graph-union.md)
- [mutated() catch-all; nested mutations do not bubble](docs/adr/0002-mutated-catch-all-and-non-bubbling-nested-mutations.md)
- [Property is reactive, Field is plain](docs/adr/0003-property-is-reactive-field-is-plain.md)
- [Graph-attaching factories return Bindings](docs/adr/0004-graph-attaching-factories-return-bindings.md)

## Packages

- [@io-gui/core](packages/core/): the reactive system — ReactiveObject, ReactiveElement, properties, bindings, VDOM, theming; everything else builds on this
- [@io-gui/inputs](packages/inputs/): basic input elements (buttons, switches, string/number fields)
- [@io-gui/sliders](packages/sliders/): slider elements
- [@io-gui/colors](packages/colors/): color pickers and editors
- [@io-gui/menus](packages/menus/): hierarchical option trees as dropdowns, menu bars, context menus, trees
- [@io-gui/navigation](packages/navigation/): navigator elements that present a Menu and mirror its selection
- [@io-gui/layout](packages/layout/): IDE-like tabbed, split, drag-and-drop panel layouts
- [@io-gui/editors](packages/editors/): object inspector elements
- [@io-gui/markdown](packages/markdown/): markdown viewer element
- [@io-gui/icons](packages/icons/): icon set
- [@io-gui/three](packages/three/): Three.js UI elements

## Source

- [Core source](packages/core/src/): `nodes/` and `elements/` hold the base classes, `core/` the property/binding/dispatch machinery, `vdom/` the tag functions, `decorators/` Register/Property/Field
- [API reference](docs/generated/api/): TypeDoc-generated API docs (regenerate with `pnpm docs:api`)
